name: What should I prepare before listing my luxury property?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before listing my luxury property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before listing your luxury property, focus on presentation, documentation, and property readiness. This includes professional staging, completing any necessary repairs or upgrades, and gathering all relevant property documents such as surveys, appraisal reports, and renovation permits. A representative like Kelby Contreras can provide a checklist to ensure your property in areas like Coral Gables or Pinecrest is impeccably prepared to attract discerning buyers and maximize its appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before listing, prepare by professionally staging your property, completing any needed repairs, and gathering all important property documentation like surveys and permits.
